verdict.rationale: Scheduling and event triggers are a fair question for an intelligent-device agent platform, but the evidence describes only interactive voice use (capturing audio, Realtime API voice mode) and profile customization. Nothing documents scheduled tasks, cron-like recurrence, or triggering a task from an external event or webhook.

support.subject: As a power user, I can schedule a device task or trigger it from an external event, not only run it interactively
